key_grammar.source_sentence: He concluded that the view of the universe accepted at the time―that the Sun traveled around Earth―was wrong, and that it was in fact Earth that traveled around the Sun.

explanation.text: 명사 the view 뒤의 that절이 그 view의 '구체적 내용'을 그대로 풀어 설명하는 동격 that이다.
동격 that절은 앞 명사와 '='로 이어지는 완전한 문장이며, 뒤에 빠진 성분이 없다.
관계대명사 that은 뒤 문장에 주어·목적어가 비어 있지만, 동격 that은 뒤가 완전한 절이다.
concluded that(명사절 목적어), Earth that traveled(it-that 강조)처럼 여러 that이 섞여 있어 역할 구분이 중요하다.
동격 that절이 대시(―)로 삽입되어 주어 the view와 본동사 was 사이에 끼어 있음에 유의한다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 명사구 the view of the universe를 대시로 삽입된 동격 that절 'that the Sun traveled around Earth'가 부연 설명한다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: He concluded [[1|that]] the view of the universe [[2|accepted]] at the time―[[3|that]] the Sun traveled around Earth―[[4|were]] wrong, and that it was in fact Earth [[5|that]] traveled around the Sun.
drills.fix: 삽입된 동격 that절 뒤 본동사의 주어는 단수 the view이므로, were가 아니라 원문의 was가 되어야 한다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: [[Using/Used]] a telescope, the Italian scientist Galileo Galilei [[discovered/discovering]] the four largest moons of Jupiter and [[observed/observing]] craters on Earth's Moon.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
options: Even before telescopes existed, people looked out into space and tried to understand the universe.
The Egyptians, Babylonians, Greeks, and Maya was among the first peoples to map the movements of the stars.
In Europe, a 16th-century Polish mathematician named Nicolaus Copernicus put forth a revolutionary idea.
Despite widespread objections to his ideas, he published his theory in a book.
He also confirmed that Copernicus' theory was correct.
drills.answer: The Egyptians, Babylonians, Greeks, and Maya was among the first peoples to map the movements of the stars.
drills.fix: 주어가 복수(The Egyptians, Babylonians, Greeks, and Maya)이므로 was가 아니라 원문의 were가 맞다.

drills.question: 지구가 태양 주위를 돈다는 그 생각은 혁명적이었다. (in order to가 아니라 동격 that을 사용할 것)
drills.answer: The idea that Earth traveled around the Sun was revolutionary.

drills.question: 유럽에서, Nicolaus Copernicus라는 이름의 16세기 폴란드 수학자가 혁명적인 생각을 제시했다.
drills.answer: In Europe, a 16th-century Polish mathematician named Nicolaus Copernicus put forth a revolutionary idea.
